math_review.definitions: Matched achieved error comparison evaluates work and wall-time cost only for solvers achieving empirical error <= E at target level E on the identical grid, state scaling, and norm.
assumptions: Comparison occurs on identical 101-point uniform grid against authoritative reference solution.
No interpolation across solver failure boundaries or extrapolation beyond empirical bracketing levels.
math_review.derivation: Log-linear interpolation between consecutive achieved error levels (e_1, w_1) and (e_2, w_2) with e_2 <= E <= e_1 yields matched cost log(w) = log(w_1) + [log(E) - log(e_1)] / [log(e_2) - log(e_1)] * [log(w_2) - log(w_1)].
math_review.roundoff_model: Binary64 floating-point arithmetic with outward error monitoring on reference crosscheck.
counterexamples: Netlib DVODE completely failed on oscillatory Belousov-Zhabotinsky limit cycle (oregonator), preserved as failed row without interpolation.
Non-bracketing rows are preserved as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY rather than extrapolated.
